scope: open-source readiness review of fixed worktree, reachable Git history, published darwin/arm64 asset, isolated behavior tests and read-only local WorkBuddy probe

gitleaks_history_findings.classification: synthetic canary in TestParserCanaryInExcludedRecordsNeverLeaks; not a confirmed real credential

credential_scan.external_skill_config_permissions: 0644; parent .mcporter 0755; home 0750, so readable by principals with directory traversal; outside repository

new_findings.title: Go 1.26.0 release toolchain has known vulnerable standard-library call paths
new_findings.evidence: govulncheck 1.9.0 CLI source scan and go version -m released artifact
new_findings.scope_note: 27 static symbol-reachable advisory IDs do not establish 27 exploitable vulnerabilities; no exploits attempted

new_findings.title: MCP credentials are forwarded on cross-host redirects
new_findings.scope_note: requires MCP endpoint or configured proxy to redirect; no evidence of a real-world leak

new_findings.title: Errors expose signed download URLs and reflected MCP credentials
new_findings.scope_note: signed URL case needs only a network failure; raw MCP token case requires server reflection; synthetic fixtures only

new_findings.title: Skill reauthorization does not refresh saved credentials
new_findings.scope_note: tested credential selection/refresh helpers used by setup; did not expire or use a real credential

new_findings.title: Manual recovery is classified as an automatically recoverable setup delay
new_findings.scope_note: isolated setup with fake relay recovery_needed; current fixture proves misleading output, not actual cloud recovery

findings.summary: Incorrect enforcement of email constraints in crypto/x509
Panic in name constraint checking for malformed certificates in crypto/x509
Incorrect parsing of IPv6 host literals in net/url
FileInfo can escape from a Root in os
Case-sensitive excludedSubtrees name constraints cause Auth Bypass in crypto/x509
Unauthenticated TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate record can cause persistent connection retention and DoS in crypto/tls
Infinite loop in HTTP/2 transport when given bad SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE in net/http/internal/http2 in golang.org/x/net
Inefficient policy validation in crypto/x509
Unexpected work during chain building in crypto/x509
Panic in Dial and LookupPort when handling NUL byte on Windows in net
Invoking failure to reject ASCII-only Punycode-encoded labels in golang.org/x/net/idna
Inefficient candidate hostname parsing in crypto/x509
Arbitrary inputs are included in errors without any escaping in net/textproto
Invoking Encrypted Client Hello privacy leak in crypto/tls
Enforce maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
Limit handshake messages we are willing to accept post-handshake in crypto/tls
Avoid quadratic complexity in resolvePath in net/url
HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to Trailer headers in net/http
HTTP/1 client connection desynchronization after CONNECT rejection in net/http
Reject malformed ECH outer extension references in crypto/tls
Memory limit bypass when parsing MIME headers in net/textproto, mime/multipart
HTTP/2 transport accepts malformed framing-related headers in net/http
Excessive CPU consumption from repeated initial window changes in net/http
Double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server streams in net/http
HTTP/1 server connection desynchronization after 2xx CONNECT response in net/http
HTTP/2 server crash due to HPACK encoder race in net/http
Distrust compromised intermediate certificates in crypto/x509

govulncheck.note: Static symbol reachability does not establish exploitability; JSON mode returns zero even with findings.

limitations: No real cloud account used; exact token matching happened only in local memory with no credential values emitted.
No actual second-device or WorkBuddy GUI/model continuation acceptance.
Read-only structural probe does not prove native installation or model continuation.
Historical secret scan covers locally reachable refs; cannot prove absence of unknown or previously externally copied secrets.
Runtime leakage repros use synthetic tokens and local HTTP servers/custom transports.
Only the published darwin/arm64 asset was downloaded and inspected.
Nine deferred functional bugs remain; normal test-suite success is not release readiness.
No source changes, credential rotation, remote edits, commits, tags or publication were performed in this review.
